(async()=>{const a=await import('/src/studio/assistant/appTools.ts');const s=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const tools=a.appTools;const job=s.useStudio.getState().job.id;const list=await tools.find(t=>t.name==='read_work_packet').execute({expectedJobId:job});const packets=JSON.parse(list.content[0].text).packets;if(!packets.length)throw Error('No packets retrievable');const p=await tools.find(t=>t.name==='read_work_packet').execute({expectedJobId:job,packetId:packets[0].id});const e=await tools.find(t=>t.name==='read_work_packet_event').execute({expectedJobId:job,packetId:packets[0].id});if(!JSON.parse(e.content[0].text).events.length)throw Error('No archived events');let blocked=false;try{const rejected=await tools.find(t=>t.name==='read_work_packet').execute({expectedJobId:job,packetId:'another-project-packet'});blocked=!!rejected.isError}catch{blocked=true}if(!blocked)throw Error('Packet isolation failed');return {retrieval:true,eventIndex:true,unknownPacketRejected:true}})()
